name: Tiny Frog 22
author: newrocker2468
description: Neon rounded emerald button that glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, width becomes 120px, height becomes 60px, border-radius becomes 10px. On focus, border becomes 5px solid #a0fad8.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Tiny Frog 22</title>
<style>
/* Tiny Frog 22 by newrocker2468 — https://uiverse.io/newrocker2468/tiny-frog-22 */
.button1 {
  background-color: white;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 1em;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 1.2em;
  color: rgb(0, 0, 0);
  cursor: pointer;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 500ms;
  z-index: 99;
}

.button1::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  width: 25px;
  height: 25px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  bottom: -30px;
  left: 45px;
  background-color: #5affc0;
  z-index: -99;
  transition: all 500ms;
}

.button1:hover::after {
  width: 120px;
  height: 60px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  transition: all 500ms;
  bottom: -1px;
  left: -1px;
}

.button1:hover {
  border-radius: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 100px 20px #5affc0;
}

.button1:active {
  transform: translateY(10px);
}

.button1:focus {
  border: 5px solid #a0fad8;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button1">
 Click me!
</button>

</body>
</html>
